summary: Battalion Oil Corp filed an 8-K on 2026-05-13 reporting its Q1 2026 financial results per Items 2.02 and 8.01. The press release in Exhibit 99.1 includes non-GAAP measures such as EBITDA, LTM EBITDA, and adjusted earnings. No special-situation transaction—acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change—is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release with no deal terms or corporate-event catalysts.
